features.name: v1_zscore
features.description: Standardized V1 using training mean and std for linear margin scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth standardized input aiding linear SVM margin geometry.

features.name: v2_zscore
features.description: Standardized V2 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth standardized projection for linear separator.

features.name: v3_zscore
features.description: Standardized V3 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes scale of V3 with V1 and V2 for hyperplane fitting.

features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2 capturing relative balance, clipped to a stable range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relational structure linearly that raw features cannot.

features.name: v1_v2_abs_diff_norm
features.description: Absolute difference between V1 and V2 normalized by their sum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Symmetric measure of disparity useful as a linear feature.

features.name: v1_v2_mean_log
features.description: Log-transformed average of V1 and V2 to compress high-magnitude tails.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth monotonic composite supporting linear weighting.

features.name: v3_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of V3 from its training mean, a continuous severity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights atypical V3 values which may carry margin signal.

features.name: v3_squared_dev
features.description: Squared deviation of V3 from its mean, emphasizing extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides quadratic-style signal that remains linear in input space.

features.name: v1_v2_product_scaled
features.description: Scaled product of V1 and V2 to encode joint magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures interaction between V1 and V2 with bounded scale for SVM.

features.name: v3_weighted_v1v2
features.description: V3 weighted by normalized average of V1 and V2, a composite intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines all three inputs into a single smooth weighted projection.

features.name: row_extremity_score
features.description: Semantic estimate of how extreme the row's combined V1, V2, V3 values are relative to typical training distribution, derived from standardized magnitudes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth holistic outlierness measure that can shift linear margins.

features.name: spatial_symmetry_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of spatial symmetry between V1 and V2 modulated by V3, judging whether the row reflects a balanced configuration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded symmetry score that helps the linear separator capture geometric balance.
